rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when saying that two things are connected or associated.

example.english: This report is related to the matter.
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 bou3 dou6 tung4 gin6 si6 jau5 gwaan1

rows.traditional: 同 A 有關嘅 N
rows.jyutping: tung4 A jau5 gwaan1 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this modifier before a noun for something connected to the topic named by A, such as a gun-related crime.

example.english: This crime related to guns remains unsolved.
example.traditional: 呢單同槍械有關嘅罪案仲未破案。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 tung4 coeng1 haai6 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 zeoi6 on3 zung6 mei6 po3 on3
